evidence.text: Categories: Coffee Shop / Café Café Pascal Vasastan Stina Bengtsson A block from busy Odenplan, on a quiet corner, you'll find Café Pascal. In 2019 the coffee house won the prestigious Gulddraken award for best café in Stockholm. Great coffee and sandwiches with shrimp or porchetta to die for!
